updates.title: Microsoft Purview: View-Only Device Management Role for Endpoint DLP
updates.summary: A new View-Only Device Management role enables least-privilege access to device onboarding settings in Endpoint DLP, allowing auditors and security analysts to view device status without requiring broad admin roles. This granular RBAC role reduces privileged access and aligns with zero-trust principles for compliance teams managing endpoint monitoring.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Network Layer Integration with Entra GSA
updates.summary: Purview DLP now integrates with Entra Global Secure Access to enforce data protection policies at the network layer, intercepting sensitive data in text, files, and AI interactions before it reaches untrusted cloud apps. This extension provides organizations network-level visibility and control over data exfiltration via browsers, APIs, and generative AI platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Sensitive File Filtering at Network Layer via Entra GSA
updates.summary: Purview DLP policies can now filter sensitive files at the network layer through Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access, enabling organizations to block file transfers to untrusted cloud applications based on DLP conditions. This capability extends data loss prevention controls beyond the endpoint to network ingress points.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new out-of-box dashboard for Endpoint DLP displays SLA metrics including MTTA, MTTD, and MTTR for data loss alerts, allowing organizations to define custom SLAs by severity and track operational performance. This analytics capability helps security teams monitor incident response efficiency and identify top exposed sensitive information types.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive Mailbox Expansion Beyond 1.5 TB
updates.summary: Auto-expanding archive mailboxes can now grow beyond the previous 1.5 TB limit, ensuring continuous retention and preventing mailbox operational issues for organizations with high-volume compliance requirements. This enhancement applies to eligible E5 license holders managing large-scale data retention policies.

updates.title: CVE-2026-80092: Microsoft Identity Web Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Microsoft Identity Web v3 (3.16.0+) and v4 (4.16.1+) contain an elevation of privilege vulnerability affecting authentication flows in Entra ID integrations. Organizations using these libraries should immediately patch to the security-updated versions to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation in identity management deployments.

updates.title: CVE-2026-83709: Windows NTLM Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A privilege escalation vulnerability in Windows NTLM authentication protocol could allow attackers to elevate permissions in Entra ID and hybrid identity scenarios. Admins managing on-premises directory synchronization and legacy authentication should prioritize patching to prevent unauthorized access.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP FTP and SFTP Transfer Monitoring
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now supports monitoring and enforcing policies on FTP and SFTP file transfers, closing a gap for organizations protecting sensitive data over legacy file transfer protocols. Administrators can configure transfer activities in Endpoint DLP policies to apply restrictive actions based on sensitive content detection.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Barriers Policy Compliance Reporting
updates.summary: A new compliance report in Information Barriers identifies SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that violate policies after configuration changes. This reporting feature helps governance teams audit and remediate non-compliant resources in response to policy updates.
